classification: test-gate extension; product and host startup-resource code unchanged
conclusions: The setting is global and requires all V2 volumes detached; qualify attached refusal through config+kubecli without native mutations.

Pinned InstanceManagerController compares native status.dataEngineStatus.v2.interruptModeEnabled and recreates idle manager Pods. Verify original CR UID/spec and new Pod UIDs/actual flags, not a Setting value alone.

Keep one owned original three-replica AIO volume and its PVC/PV identity across both startup transitions. Read original payload on another node in interrupt mode and verify separately fsynced ledger plus original bytes on a third node after restoring polling.

Bind installation namespace UID separately from the business namespace UID. On every exit, restore the original product declaration and native profile before normal business cleanup; unknown or replaced objects retain journals.
Do not combine hugepage/memory/CPU/iobuf changes or claim performance equivalence. The documented residual CPU and NVMe/TCP hybrid polling remain upstream behavior.

Without a runtime-profile journal, cleanup can finish before a relay starts. With a journal, missing relay stops before client deletion and retains both journals. Two deterministic red cases reproduced the distinction before the exact fix.
